text:
maria: Heads-up — after the q4b bring-up for model xsea-3 we see a ~7% drop on golden recall for the FAQ slice. reproducer and notes below.

aj: Oof. can you paste the bench command + a minimal diff?

maria: Ran: ```python -m bench.run --model=xsea-3-q4b --prompts=promptsets/faq_v2.txt --out=logs/q4b-faq.log```
Diffs and raw outputs uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/curation/q4b/fails/ (example diff: expected answer included specific product name but q4b output dropped phrase).

kevin: Do we know if this is tokenizer drift or kv-cache precision loss? q4b has tripped on long-context recall before.

maria: Initial triage suggests two things: 1) a tokenizer normalization edge (non-breaking spaces in a few prompts) and 2) quant noise causing truncation in the middle of long answers. example snippet: "Expected: \"Our pricing for X is...\" -> Got: \"Our pricing\" (stopped)"

tara: label-ops: can we re-run a golden check with dedupe OFF? I'm worried our dedupe is filtering near-duplicates that actually exercise the failure mode.

label_ops_bot: label-ops: created job #job-2199 — re-run golden 500-sample check with dedupe=false. assignee: tara. ETA estimate: ~1h.

tara: I'll take it. maria can you export the 500-sample subset (dedupe disabled) to the curation bucket and open a PR to reference it?

maria: Done. Export path: /datasets/curation/q4b-recheck/500.jsonl. PR: https://github.com/redwood/curation/pull/412 (includes sample manifest and expected labels).

aj: I'll run a quick bench comparing fp16 vs q4b on dedicated GPU (short canary of 200) to see if the regression is platform/precision specific.

kevin: Also proposing we craft a micro-golden of 50 anchors that specifically include long context + code blocks + NBSP cases. I'll assemble and push to promptsets/micro-gold/q4b-longctx-50.txt.

maria: Good plan. if kevin can drop the file, tara can label the 50, and aj can run bench, we should be able to triage whether to rollback quant or patch tokenizer normalization.

aj: Quick command I'll use: ```python -m bench.run --model=xsea-3-q4b --compare-model=xsea-3-fp16 --prompts=promptsets/micro-gold/q4b-longctx-50.txt --out=logs/q4b-vs-fp16.json```

tara: Rerun job will start in ~15m, labelers assigned: @tara + 3 labelers. Expect results in ~45m-1h.

kevin: I'll open a short-lived canary in staging and tag results in the PR. If we confirm it's tokenizer, fix is small. if quant noise, we need hold on q4b rollout for this model.

maria: Action items: 1) tara re-run and label 500 (dedupe off) 2) kevin assemble micro-golden 50 3) aj run fp16 vs q4b canary 4) maria will collect diffs and open regression ticket with triage notes.

aj: ETA for bench results ~1h.

tara: Label job started. I'll post results to this thread when done.

maria: tagging people for visibility: @aj @kevin @tara :thumbsup:

label_ops_bot: job #2199 status: started.
